name: build-from-spec-plugin
description: Build a complete native Android app from appy.fyi's build-spec.json, with deterministic launcher-icon generation.

plugins.name: build-from-spec-plugin
plugins.description: Build a complete native Android app end-to-end from a self-contained build-spec.json — claim it on appy.fyi's website, then fetch it via /list + /build (which can build several claimed apps in parallel, each in its own subfolder of a shared apps root) or drop it in by hand — including a /readme command, a /publish command that walks through one-time Play Console/Cloud setup and uploads builds to internal testing via the Google Play Developer API, a deterministic launcher icon, and Play In-App Review/Integrity client-API integration.
